The Supabase Free plan's 5 GB-a-month egress is counted on every query through the pooler, the nightly backup alone spends ~1.3 GB of it, and at 2,000 members the app needs several times the allowance — after a grace period Supabase may pause the project, switch it read-only or answer 402

Hobby's 10 GB of Fast Origin Transfer is the Vercel allowance nobody counted, and two ordinary things spend it: the photograph-download converter pushes every saved photograph through a function as a fresh JPEG, and the directory re-sends its map on every search keystroke
